Fork Branch

Preserved Primary Document • fbranch.htm

The church itself is no longer used by members of the community but the graveyard is still in use. The cemetery is in two sections: the oldest section is behind the church and many of the grave markers have been consumed by the encroaching woods. The newer portion is directly across the road.
